body:
P8 effort:max area:multiaxis - triage.
This is an accepted enhancement, not a defect: a surface-based workflow needs design and research before code.
The report names two needs. Both have open tracks:
- STEP B-rep and NURBS surfaces kept beside the mesh: the solidcore programme (#27) and the spline-face deviation bound (#1029).
- Lollipop and other form cutters: #896. Native CAD and Rhino files: #1572.
effort:max - the work needs a new geometry representation and new tool-contact algorithms.
Reporter: woodwindnerd, 2026-11-15. Use case: saxophone mouthpieces, freeform chambers and undercuts, simultaneous 5-axis.

Thank you for reviewing and connecting this use case to the existing development tracks. I would be happy to provide Rhino/STEP models, cutter dimensions and practical tests on my 5-axis machine if useful.

Research summary for surface-based 5-axis finishing and lollipop cutters on STEP models.

### 1. Answers to Open Questions

**Q1. Does CamCraft discard STEP B-rep and NURBS surfaces after import?**
Yes. `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs` parses STEP files with `truck_stepio::r#in::Table`. It calls `cshell.robust_triangulation(tol)` with `MAX_CHORD = stock_sim::DEV_TOL * 0.5`. Then `crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs` stores only `schema::Facets` (`Arc<[Triangle]>`) on the model entity. `crates/app/src/project/entity.rs` (`EntityDto`) and `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` (`PROJECT_VERSION = 61`) save only `facets` to `.sc` files. Meanwhile, `crates/kernel/src/solidcore_step.rs` already reads ISO 10303-21 and ISO 10303-42 STEP data into `solidcore_record::brep::Brep`. `crates/kernel/src/machining_mesh.rs` builds a `MachiningMesh` with per-triangle face IDs (`tri_face: Vec<u32>`). Issue #917 tracks switching `crates/app` from `truck` to `solidcore` (`blocked` on #1029).

**Q2. Can CamCraft retain STEP B-rep and NURBS data beside the mesh?**
Yes. `solidcore_record::brep::Brep` derives `serde::Serialize` and `serde::Deserialize` (`VERSION = 4`). It stores analytic and NURBS surfaces (`Surface::Spline`, `RationalSpline`, `PlacedRevolution`), UV trim loops (`OrientedEdge`), and face orientations (`OrientedFace`). `crates/app` can store an optional B-rep record on STEP model entities and `.sc` project files. STL and OBJ models stay mesh-only. Existing `Revision` and `GeoSig` keys invalidate cached triangles and B-rep data together. Adding `camcraft-kernel` to `camcraft-app` requires a `docs/decisions/` record per `AGENTS.md`. Keeping a trait interface in `camcraft-geometry` keeps `camcraft-motion` free of direct `solidcore` dependencies.

**Q3. Can CamCraft calculate contact points, surface normals, and smooth 5-axis motion from the original surfaces?**
Yes, in stages. Today, `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/` (`contour5d.rs`, `parallel5d.rs`, `flow.rs`) builds an upright `+Z` ball-center path on `&[Triangle]`. Then `stamp_axes` (`stamp.rs`, `stamp_pose.rs`) calls `closest_pt_tri` (Ericson, *Real-Time Collision Detection*) inside `band = 0.01 + 1e-6 * r`. It computes contact normal `n = (p - q) / d` from the hit triangle and sets `tip = c - r * a` (`retip.rs`). `curv.rs` (`shape_operators`) estimates curvature from adjacent triangles (`CREASE_COS = 0.5`).

On STEP models, `MachiningMesh::tri_face` maps each hit triangle to its `FacePlan` and `EvalSurface` in `solidcore_tess::plan::TessPlan`. `solidcore::eval::plan::uv::project` projects point `c` onto `(u, v)`. `EvalSurface::eval` and `EvalSurface::derivs` return exact points and unit normals (Piegl & Tiller, *The NURBS Book*). `solidcore::eval::normal_section` evaluates directional curvature from partial derivatives.

However, refining `+Z` mesh passes does not reach internal undercuts. `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/support.rs` flips downward facet normals upward (`m.z < 0.0`) and checks vertical `+Z` plunge columns (`column_clear`). Deep chambers require direct surface `(u, v)` path generation instead of `+Z` heightfield scans.

**Q4. Can CamCraft retain STEP face boundaries and topology for selecting machining areas?**
Yes. Today, `crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs` clusters triangles into `FaceKind::Planar` faces, `Patch` welds below `CREASE_DEG = 40.0`, and `Chain` creases above `40.0` degrees. `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs` projects `Face` and `Patch` loops onto a flat 2D plane (`plane_xy`). That 2D projection folds and breaks on wrapped chambers and overhangs. With `Brep.faces`, `Loop`, `OrientedEdge`, and `tri_face`, selection can target exact STEP faces and B-rep edge chains (`GeoSel`). `solidcore` trim-loop queries (`contains_uv_point` in `query/loop.rs`) test `(u, v)` containment directly inside 2D trim curves.

**Q5. Can CamCraft keep the mesh for display, stock simulation, and collision checking with lollipop cutters at 0.01 mm?**
Yes. Viewport rendering, `verify::solid`, `verify::contact`, and `stock_sim::SdfField` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_sweep.rs`) read `&[Triangle]`. `MachiningMesh` supports `0.01 mm` chord bounds once #1029 lands spline-face deviation bounds. For cutters and machines:
- A spherical lollipop tip keeps sphere-center pivot invariance (`tip = c - r * a`) for cutting contact.
- `crates/tools/src/tools.rs` allows `shank_d < diameter`. `crates/tools/src/cutter_profile.rs` already draws a reduced `neck` (`SpunProfile`, #852).
- However, `crates/sim/src/verify/probe.rs` models every cutting `Atom` (`Prof::Bull`, `Flat`, `Cone`) as non-decreasing in `z`. `Prof::Bull` stops at `z = r` and cannot model a `>180 deg` sphere tapering onto a thinner neck.
- Also, `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/avoid.rs` skips `Shank` checks when `shank_r <= r + EXC`. It uses an upright box gate (`bx[5] <= h0`) and clamps escape tilt to `85.0` degrees.
- Issue #896 covers `FormMill` overhang profiles, piecewise necked `SpunProfile` checks in `verify::probe` and `swept`, and `SdfField` undercut simulation. (`Dexel` columns cannot represent undercuts.)
- Issue #1572 covers native Rhino `.3dm` import, so this work targets Rhino STEP exports first. `crates/post/src/` already provides 5-axis RTCP (`G43.4`) and `G93` inverse-time post support.

---

### 2. Design Proposal (Smallest Useful First Slice First)

1. **Slice 1: Retain STEP B-rep data and face IDs on STEP entities** *(depends on #917 and #1029)*
   Store optional `solidcore_record::brep::Brep` and `MachiningMesh::tri_face` beside `schema::Facets` on imported STEP entities and in `.sc` files. Keep STL and OBJ files mesh-only. Keep `Facets` active for rendering, `Dexel`/`SdfField` simulation, roughing, and 2D operations. Record the `camcraft-kernel` dependency edge in `docs/decisions/`.

2. **Slice 2: Add a surface-evaluation seam and refine 5-axis normals**
   Define a pure surface-query trait in `camcraft-geometry` (point projection, oriented unit normal, partial derivatives, UV containment) and implement it in `camcraft-kernel`. Update `stamp_axes` (`stamp_pose.rs`) to project ball centers onto the hit triangle's B-rep face and evaluate smooth exact normals. Keep the triangle fallback for STL and OBJ files.

3. **Slice 3: Add exact STEP face selection and UV iso-parametric finishing**
   Expose `tri_face` and `Brep` topology through `GeoSel` so users select STEP faces and boundary edges directly. Add a 5-axis finishing generator that steps in surface `(u, v)` space inside `Loop` trim curves instead of projecting `+Z` heightfields.

4. **Slice 4: Support 3D undercut avoidance and reduced-neck lollipop cutters** *(depends on #896)*
   Replace the upright `+Z` column gate and `85.0 deg` tilt cap in `multiaxis/avoid.rs` with full 3D capsule collision checks along arbitrary tool axes. Wire `#896` `FormMill` lollipop profiles, necked `SpunProfile` checks in `verify::probe`, and `SdfField` undercut cuts into 5-axis chamber finishing. Validate against a representative Rhino STEP mouthpiece model at `0.01 mm`.

---

### 3. Proposed Sub-Issues (For Maintainer Approval — Not Filed Yet)

Issue #1955 carries `P8` without `needs-research`. This comment lists proposed sub-issues for approval before anyone files them.

1. **Retain STEP B-rep record and face map on imported STEP models**
   This task stores `solidcore_record::brep::Brep` and `MachiningMesh::tri_face` on STEP entities in `camcraft-app` and `.sc` project files while keeping STL and OBJ mesh-only (depends on #917, #1029).
   Done means: STEP import populates optional B-rep data and `tri_face`. `.sc` save and load preserve both. STL and OBJ paths stay unchanged.
   Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`

2. **Expose a surface query trait over `solidcore` evaluation and `tri_face`**
   This task defines a surface-query trait in `camcraft-geometry` and implements it in `camcraft-kernel` using `TessPlan` and `uv::project`.
   Done means: Unit tests project sample points onto analytic and spline STEP faces within `0.001 mm`. Returned normals follow `OrientedFace` directions across face seams.
   Proposed: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:3d`

3. **Refine 5-axis `stamp_axes` contact points and normals from STEP surfaces**
   This task updates `stamp_pose` (`Contour5D`, `Parallel5D`, `Flow5D`, `MultiAxisContour`) to evaluate contact points and smooth normals on STEP surfaces when present.
   Done means: 5-axis ball-nose passes on curved STEP faces eliminate facet-boundary normal jumps. Generated paths pass `verify::contact` and `verify::solid` at `0.01 mm`.
   Proposed: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`

4. **Support STEP B-rep face and edge selection in `GeoSel`**
   This task lets viewport picking and `GeoSel` select exact STEP faces and B-rep edges via `tri_face` instead of planar clusters and `40 deg` crease patches (`Patch`).
   Done means: Users select curved NURBS faces and boundary edges across `.sc` save and load. STL and OBJ models keep mesh feature picking.
   Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`

5. **Add UV iso-parametric 5-axis surface finishing trimmed by STEP loops**
   This task generates 5-axis passes directly in face `(u, v)` space bounded by `contains_uv_point` (`query/loop.rs`) instead of `+Z` heightfield scans.
   Done means: Toolpaths follow natural surface curves across steep freeform STEP faces at `0.01 mm` chordal tolerance without `+Z` shadow gaps.
   Proposed: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`

6. **Generalize 5-axis neck and shank avoidance for undercuts and internal chambers**
   This task replaces the upright `+Z` column gate and `85.0 deg` tilt cap in `multiaxis/avoid.rs` with 3D vector capsule checks for arbitrary tool axes and reduced necks.
   Done means: 5-axis finishing handles undercut normals (`n.z < 0`) and internal chamber entry cones. Collision checks test reduced necks, shanks, and holders against the part mesh.
   Proposed: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`

7. **Connect #896 lollipop cutters and `SdfField` undercut simulation to 5-axis finishing**
   This task wires `#896` `FormMill` lollipop geometry, necked `SpunProfile` verification in `verify::probe`, and `SdfField` undercut simulation into 5-axis finishing (depends on #896).
   Done means: A 5-axis chamber test fixture with a reduced-neck lollipop cutter finishes an overhanging STEP chamber at `0.01 mm`. The path passes `verify` and `SdfField` checks cleanly.
   Proposed: `P8`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`, `area:sim`
